Definition: apparently a shortened form of G3161; Matthias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Matthias.
BiblicalUsage: Matthias is the man the apostles chose by lot to take Judas's place. He had been with them from John's baptism to the ascension, and the lot fell on him, and he was numbered with the eleven.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Matthias is the apostle nobody remembers, and that is his glory: he was faithful for years without a title, and when the lot fell on him he was ready. God keeps the faithful in reserve.
